drop.title: The Ledger Where the Prime Race Runs Even

title: The Ledger Where the
Prime Race Runs Even
slides.dek: The prime race leans hard toward one team and stays there, 4k+3 ahead 99% of the way to three million. But the lean is an accounting artifact. Weigh every prime power the way analytic number theory actually does, and the same race comes out a dead tie. Here is the honest ledger, drawn, and the smooth √x shadow hiding in the gap.

statement: a coin flip on the other.
slides.body: Split the odd primes by their remainder mod 4: the *4k+1* team (5, 13, 17, ...) against *4k+3* (3, 7, 11, ...). Dirichlet proved in 1837 that both are infinite and equal in density. And yet run the race and *4k+3 leads almost the entire way,* still ahead 99% of the road at three million. That is Chebyshev's bias, noticed in 1853. Weight each prime by ln p and the lean does not budge, that leaning tally is the function number theorists call *θ (theta).*

One rule fixes it. Do not stop at the primes, count every *prime power* too, 9 and 27 and 81, 25 and 125, each also weighted ln p. That larger tally is Chebyshev's *ψ (psi)*, the count the deep theory is written in. Drawn beside the raw race, ψ settles onto the tie line and crosses it thousands of times. Subtract one race from the other and the gap is not noise, it tracks a plain *√x.* Why? Square any odd prime and you land ≡ 1 mod 4 (9, 25, 49, 121), so every prime square drops into the underdog's lane, about √x of them, exactly the weight 4k+1 was running behind. ψ collects both halves and comes out even.

lines.sub: the standing sequel to prime-race (#035), which asserted its punchline only in prose. makes the smoothed count the subject and draws both races on one axis. reuses #026/#033/#035's sieve(n) verbatim, integer-exact, deterministic, SSR-safe, zero external factual surface
a new ψ (von-Mangoldt-weighted) prime-power walk splitting θ off as the k=1 slice, the two-race overlay on one ln p axis, and a power-by-power ledger of the correction, run for mod 4 and mod 3 alike

checked offline, matched live in out/: to 3M, raw 4k+3 leads 99.09% (θ) but ψ is 52.4/47.6, a near tie. the C=1713.4 gap is reproduced exactly by the prime powers, the squares (k=2) alone supplying 1683.1 ≈ √N
